rule_of_thumb: Decision 3 (24 Sep 2026): a condition that appears in more than one sheet has ONE owner rule, chosen by domain — data → CMDB / Enterprise DQ, mechanism → ITOM, platform configuration → Platform, process → ITSM. The owner's base severity applies; the others become references that show the owner's result in context, are scored only in the owner module, and are counted once in Overall.
method: Candidates were found by comparing rule wording across sheets, then read against each rule's Source Tables / Fields. Pairs that read different objects were dropped. For example, ITOM-091/115 read em_event while PLT-115/117 read sysevent, and CMDB-044/054 judge IRE identification rules while ITOM-097/102 judge event match rules. The data-quality sheet's CMDB Quality rows restate CMDB rules; that is an equivalence recorded per rule in overlays/data-quality.json (`equivalent_of`), not an ownership question.

relations.duplicate: the same condition on the same objects
relations.overlap: one rule's scope contains the other's, or they share a detection; resolved by a scope split or a shared detection rather than one owner

conditions.condition: Network IP ranges present in CIs with no matching discovery schedule / range
conditions.basis: Mechanism: discovery schedule coverage is ITOM configuration. CMDB-071/DQ-059 reference it. AGREED (D-023): the product owner assigned the condition to CMDB-071; it is evaluated and counted in CMDB, with CMDB-071's severity (Critical). The ITOM row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Discovery coverage ratio below threshold
conditions.basis: Mechanism. Today CMDB-070 is a CMDB trust-gate blocker (measured_kpi); under ownership ITOM-002 carries it as a blocker whose `blocks` names the CMDB dimensions it undermines (approach §5). AGREED (D-023): the product owner assigned the condition to CMDB-070; it is evaluated and counted in CMDB, with CMDB-070's severity (Systemic). The ITOM row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Priority band with record volume and no SLA definition
conditions.basis: Platform configuration: SLA definitions are SLA engineering (Platform 1A). ITSM-003 references it. AGREED (D-025): kept in the module where it is built — ITSM-003 evaluates and counts it; the Platform row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Knowledge articles referenced in resolutions but retired or unpublished
conditions.basis: The workbook itself says so: DQ-131's Cross-Domain Link reads "Duplicates ITSM-139 from the data quality side". Process. AGREED (D-027): ITSM-139 evaluates and counts it; the Enterprise DQ row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Credentials stored outside the credential vault
conditions.basis: Platform configuration. PLT-139 covers all credential storage; ITOM-024 is the discovery-credential subset and references it.

conditions.condition: Incidents referencing a Business Service vs a bare CI vs neither
conditions.basis: Three ratios over the same incident population (incident.cmdb_ci / business_service). ITSM-016 and ITSM-017 ask a process question; CMDB-117/DQ-078 is the CMDB D10 consumption KPI. Proposal: compute the population once and let each rule read it, with no single owner. Needs a decision on whether CMDB D10 keeps CMDB-117.

conditions.condition: Class / table extension depth beyond recommended
conditions.basis: Scope split: CMDB-120/DQ-083 own the cmdb_ci tree ("sys_db_object super_class chain within the CMDB tree"); PLT-170 owns every other table and excludes the CMDB tree. AGREED (D-025): kept in the module where it is built — CMDB-120 evaluates and counts it; the Platform row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Groups with zero active members, by the role that references them
conditions.basis: Shared detection: one resolution of active group membership, read by each rule for its own reference role (CI support group, assignment group, approver, provisioning approver). DQ-096's Cross-Domain Link names CMDB-102, ITSM-101 and ITOM-142. Each rule stays scored in its module because it judges a different reference.

conditions.condition: Integration / connector with no error handling or retry
conditions.basis: Scope split: ITOM-093 owns Event Management connectors; PLT-141 owns every other integration and excludes them.

conditions.condition: Notifications firing to inactive users or empty groups
conditions.basis: Scope split: PLT-024 owns SLA breach notifications (SLA engineering); ITSM-011 owns every other ITSM notification rule and excludes them. AGREED (D-025): kept in the module where it is built — ITSM-011 evaluates and counts it; the Platform row shows it as an equivalent.

conditions.condition: Application Service with no supporting CIs
conditions.basis: The same detection over both mechanisms (svc_ci_assoc and cmdb_rel_ci). AGREED (D-030): CMDB-110 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-110's result.

conditions.condition: Percentage of principal CIs reachable from a Business Capability
conditions.basis: The same traversal and ratio; CSDM-068 says "Joins CMDB-112". AGREED (D-030): CMDB-112 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-112's result.

conditions.condition: Service association with no relationship path
conditions.basis: The same detection; CSDM-053 says "Joins CMDB-113". AGREED (D-030): CMDB-113 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-113's result.

conditions.condition: svc_ci_assoc and cmdb_rel_ci disagreeing
conditions.basis: The same symmetric difference per service; CSDM-054 says "Joins CMDB-114". AGREED (D-030): CMDB-114 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-114's result.

conditions.condition: Production service supported by non-production CIs
conditions.basis: The same condition; CSDM-047 says "Joins CMDB-111". AGREED (D-030): CMDB-111 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-111's result.

conditions.condition: Incidents referencing a service rather than a bare CI
conditions.basis: The same measure complemented, over incidents with either reference; CSDM-069 says "Joins ITSM-017". AGREED (D-030): ITSM-017 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows ITSM-017's result.

conditions.condition: Service referenced in incidents but absent from the CSDM model
conditions.basis: The same condition and wording; CSDM-076 says "Joins ITSM-136". AGREED (D-030): ITSM-136 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows ITSM-136's result.

conditions.condition: Service owner is an inactive user
conditions.basis: CMDB-103 judges every CI's owner, service records included: CSDM-034's records are a subset. AGREED (D-030): CMDB-103 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-103's result.

conditions.condition: Service support group with zero active members
conditions.basis: CMDB-102 judges every CI's support group, service records included; CSDM-035 and CSDM-077 judge the same service records. AGREED (D-030): CMDB-102 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-102's result.

conditions.condition: Service relationships pointing at retired CIs
conditions.basis: CMDB-080 judges every edge of a retired CI; CSDM-057's service edges are a subset. CSDM-057 says "Joins CMDB-080". AGREED (D-030): CMDB-080 evaluates and counts it; the CSDM rule is not evaluated or scored in CSDM — it shows CMDB-080's result.
